title: ChurchBaptismRecord
description: Standardized schema for historical ecclesiastical baptismal, christening, and infant dedication registers and certificates.

description.description: [REQUIRED] Contextual summary of this baptism record (e.g., '1888 Baptism of Mary Lehman (First Lutheran Church, Newville, Cumberland Co., PA)').

record_category.description: Classification category for church and ecclesiastical registers.

record_type.description: Physical classification of the baptismal instrument.

church.description: Church parish or congregation facility. Church name is populated in church.details.location_name.

locator.description: Register page, volume, or entry number. Matches register_church_patterns in schemas/naming/_token_registry.json.

denomination.description: Denomination (e.g., Lutheran, Reformed, Presbyterian, Catholic, Methodist).

volume_title.description: Title or description of the church register book (e.g., 'Parish Register 1840–1905').

person_id.description: Foreign key referencing the master Person Registry (/data/entities/people.json).

full_name.description: Candidate's name parsed canonically or captured via raw_name.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth if recorded in the baptismal ledger.

date_of_baptism.description: Date baptism or christening was performed.

baptism_note.description: Optional notes regarding clerk annotations, illegible German script, or ledger condition.

transcript.description: Verbatim transcript of the register entry, abstract summary, and keyword indexing.

media_files.description: Scans of the church ledger page or baptismal certificate.

associated_people.description: Linked participants (baptized person, father, mother, officiator, godparents/sponsors) with roles and person IDs.
